headline: 191 commits today
prose:
**Fri 20 Nov** — Release plumbing, mostly. StarRupture-ModLoader now publishes releases as drafts, checks them, and can rebuild a stuck one whole. starrupture-ci stops its watch loops by version rather than time. Hardening, not new features.

**Thu 19 Nov** — StarRupture-ModLoader now runs unknown game builds on checked values and checks for a newer version map at every start. The starrupture-ci rig now covers a second client branch. Smaller fixes in BetterDrone, WAILA and the Plugin SDK.

**Wed 18 Nov** — A contributor's bulk textured triangles merged into StarRupture-ModLoader and its SDK, and update notes were written. Agent Plugins shipped session-sync Remote Control fixes. `[REDACTED]` logged 27 commits, 25 of them uncategorised.

**Tue 17 Nov** — Agent Plugins took the day: session-sync grew Remote Control restore after restart, seamless account switching and a custom tray icon, with review fixes between releases. StarRupture-ModLoader now runs plugin shutdown without the plugin lock held.

**Mon 16 Nov** — Mostly docs and pins. Release notes trimmed and Nexus text synced across the StarRupture plugins; starrupture-ci added PersistentIdFix to its client check. Agent Plugins can now link conversations across accounts.
